summary.short_summary: The meeting addressed strong sales from new clients, including a roll-up and a Telesales company, but highlighted significant delivery issues that jeopardize long-term success, evidenced by three major clients quitting within the first month. Shams was identified as a core delivery issue due to prioritizing internal approvals over client outcomes, adversely affecting client retention. Discussions included a refund request from Ravi, reflecting cash flow challenges due to an easy refund process that led to $10,000 being refunded. Proposed improvements included a PDF pitch deck for better sales expectations and a redesign of the onboarding process based on the successful Capital A model.
